text:
alex: quick heads up — tried running the JS SDK sample on Bun and Deno and hit import resolution + webcrypto issues.

alex: repro steps:
```
# deno run --import-map=import_map.json examples/js-sdk-deno.ts
TypeError: globalThis.crypto is undefined
at ...
```
alex: also saw errors like "Cannot use import statement outside a module" when running in Bun with commonjs-style entry
mira: fwiw import maps + conditional exports are the usual suspects. can you paste your import_map.json?
sam: Bun's fetch/webcrypto implementations differ. in Deno `crypto.subtle` exists, in Bun sometimes it's under `globalThis.webcrypto`? also AbortSignal.canAbort isn't supported in older bun
priya: tokens/retry logic uses AbortSignal for timeouts — that'll blow up if runtime lacks proper AbortController
alex: import_map:
```
{ "imports": { "@redwood/inference": "./node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js" } }
```
alex: workaround I used: dynamic import with fallback
```
let Redwood;
try {
  Redwood = await import('@redwood/inference');
} catch (e) {
  Redwood = await import('./node_modules/@redwood/inference/dist/esm/index.js');
}
```
mira: can we add a small adapter in SDK that does `globalThis.crypto = globalThis.crypto || globalThis.webcrypto || { subtle: ... }` behind a runtime detect? keep it opt-in
sam: also typings: `@types/node` references in published .d.ts cause Deno to choke. we should ship a `types/browser.d.ts` or use `typesVersion` for conditional exports
priya: agree — DX bug: auth header retry code uses `fetch` with `signal` param — add robust check `if ('signal' in Request.prototype)`? maybe polyfill
deno-ci-bot: CI: failing on examples/js-sdk-deno.ts — see https://ci.internal/12345
alex: ok i'll open a small PR with: - docs/deno.md sample - example using import_map + dynamic fallback - small runtime guard for crypto/fetch
mira: i'll add a checklist for verifying: Deno run, Bun run, node ESM, node CJS
sam: i'll volunteer to add a TS-only build that emits a `deno/` subpath with cleaned d.ts
priya: adding to backlog for DX team. thx all :tada:
